args.question: When is a purchase request required versus a direct purchase order?
When is a purchase request required versus a direct purchase order?

clauses.document: Bahi ERP 7.2 User Manual, Purchasing and Inventory Enquiry v7.2.3
clauses.heading: 11. Purchase order entry (PUR-PO-01) › 11.7 Direct orders
clauses.text: A DIR order is refused on Save if its gross value is above the direct-order limit configured for your company (shipped default ₹50,000), with ERR-PO-0610. Raise a purchase request instead. A DIR order may not refer to a request (ERR-PO-0611).

clauses.document: Bahi ERP 7.2 User Manual, Purchasing and Inventory Enquiry v7.2.3
clauses.heading: 11. Purchase order entry (PUR-PO-01) › 11.2 Order types
clauses.text: STD (standard) orders are raised against an approved purchase request; enter the request number in Source PR. DIR (direct) orders have no request and are allowed only for small values (see §11.7). Bahi checks the type on Save.

clauses.document: Bahi ERP 7.2 User Manual, Purchasing and Inventory Enquiry v7.2.3
clauses.heading: 9. Purchase request entry (PUR-PR-01) › 9.1 Purpose
clauses.text: A purchase request (PR) asks for an item to be bought. In most companies every purchase above a set value must start with a request.

clauses.document: Bahi ERP 7.2 User Manual, Purchasing and Inventory Enquiry v7.2.3
clauses.heading: 11. Purchase order entry (PUR-PO-01) › 11.10 Quantity against the request
clauses.text: An order against a request may not be for a different item or a larger quantity than the request (ERR-PO-0604). The request is closed (CL) when the order is saved against it.

result.note: Quote the rule with its citation, e.g. (POL-PUR-001 §6.2). If a clause's status says it is replaced or not yet in force, follow the status. Stock, budgets and statuses come from Bahi.
